title: Activity Entry Builder
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Draft a Common App-style activity entry within the real character limits and get instant feedback on action verbs, specifics, and hours.

learningObjectives: Students will compose an activity entry within the Common App's character limits and revise its description to lead with an action verb and include specific, measurable detail.

controls: Hours per week and weeks per year inputs
Position, organization, and description inputs with live counters

keyQuestions: Why does the first word of a description matter so much?
What kinds of numbers can make an activity concrete?
What should you cut first when a description runs over 150 characters?
commonMisconceptions: Full sentences are required in activity descriptions.
Listing a title is enough to show what you did.
assessmentOpportunities: Students write an entry that passes every check, stays within all character limits, and shows an action, a specific detail, and a result.
